name: Rajkamal's Diet Navratan Mix (200g)
summary: Flagged: Dual MRP Under Rule 18(2) & Missing USP Under Rule 6(11)

boundingBoxes.label: DUAL MRP: ₹70 vs ₹75
boundingBoxes.detail: Discriminatory pricing for Mumbai vs Outside Mumbai

boundingBoxes.label: MISSING USP (RULE 6(11))
boundingBoxes.detail: Mandatory unit price per gram absent on 200g pack

violations.desc: Package declares dual Maximum Retail Prices ('MRP IN MUMBAI Rs. 70/-' and 'MRP O/S MUMBAI Rs. 75/-'), directly violating Rule 18(2) prohibiting discriminatory price declarations across territories.
violations.rule: PCR 2011 Rule 18(2): No manufacturer or packer shall declare different MRP on identical pre-packaged commodities for different locations/states.

violations.desc: Pre-packaged commodity of 200g net weight lacks the mandatory Unit Sale Price declaration (e.g. ₹0.35 per g).
violations.rule: PCR 2011 Rule 6(11): Mandatory declaration of unit sale price on packages exceeding 50g where quantity is not 1 integer kg.

violations.desc: Packed date printed as '05-09-16' in ambiguous hyphenated format without clear month notation.
violations.rule: PCR 2011 Clause 6(1)(d): Month and year in which commodity is manufactured or pre-packed shall be stated clearly.

compliant.label: Net Quantity
compliant.desc: Expressed in standard SI metric units ('Net Wt : 200 g').

compliant.label: Consumer Care Redressal
compliant.desc: Landline telephone (+91-22-25782103) and email address provided.

compliant.label: Packer & Premise Address
compliant.desc: Full industrial estate address and Mumbai PIN code declared.

changeLog.actionRequired: Re-print packaging with a single, uniform Maximum Retail Price (e.g., 'MRP ₹70.00 incl. of all taxes') applicable nationwide.
Add 'USP: ₹0.35 per g' declaration in close proximity to the MRP with compliant font size.
Standardize date stamping format to 'Pkd: Sep 2024' or '09/2024' to prevent consumer ambiguity.
